wp1201_source.observation: Canonical TargetHostProfile uses schema FRANKENSTEIN2_TARGET_HOST_PROFILE/v1 and serializes collector_version, generation, facts, profile_digest_sha256 plus derived counts/scope. TargetHostProfile.__post_init__ independently recomputes and validates profile_digest_sha256 over schema+collector_version+generation+facts.

wp1202_source.observation: TargetProfileProjection.from_mapping claims the same FRANKENSTEIN2_TARGET_HOST_PROFILE/v1 schema identity but expects profile_generation, profile_sha256 and a flat fields mapping. It syntax-validates profile_sha256 only and does not recompute/bind that digest to the consumed fields.

wp1202_tests.observation: Tests construct a synthetic profile shape with profile_generation/profile_sha256/fields rather than consuming canonical TargetHostProfile.as_dict output, so the cross-workpackage ABI mismatch and stale/self-attested digest path are not exercised.

contradiction.statement: WP1201 and WP1202 currently assign the same v1 target-host-profile schema identity to incompatible data shapes. Canonical WP1201 output is not directly consumable by WP1202. If a caller manually reshapes the profile into WP1202's expected form, WP1202 accepts a caller-supplied profile_sha256 without proving that it belongs to the consumed fields, so changed target facts can retain a stale/forged source-profile digest.
risk: T1 twin plans can fail to consume the canonical read-only host profile despite claiming target-profile-driven construction
manual/ad-hoc adapters can silently become an unversioned second profile authority
a stale or forged digest can label modified target fields as if they came from the original profile identity
downstream T1/T2/T3 evidence may appear target-bound while actually being bound only to caller-attested metadata

required_falsifiers: Pass TargetHostProfile.as_dict() from canonical WP1201 directly to build_t1_userspace_plan(); current expectation: fail because generation/profile_digest_sha256/facts do not match profile_generation/profile_sha256/fields.

Construct two WP1202-shaped mappings with identical profile_generation and profile_sha256 but different required fields; current expectation: both are accepted and produce different TwinBootstrapPlan digests while claiming the same source_profile_sha256.
After repair, require exactly one canonical FRANKENSTEIN2_TARGET_HOST_PROFILE/v1 wire/data contract and an explicit validated projection/adapter if WP1202 needs a reduced view.
After repair, mutate any consumed target-profile fact while preserving the old canonical digest; admission must fail closed before a TwinBootstrapPlan is produced.

Bind projection identity to canonical profile generation+digest and document which canonical fact records produce each reduced T1 field; UNKNOWN must remain UNKNOWN rather than being flattened into an unproven observed string.
repair_options: Preferred: make WP1202 consume the canonical TargetHostProfile/v1 object/dict shape, validate TargetHostProfile digest through the WP1201 canonical validator, then derive a deterministic reduced T1 projection from canonical fact records.

Alternative: introduce a separately named/versioned TARGET_HOST_PROFILE_T1_PROJECTION schema produced only by a validated adapter that binds canonical profile generation+digest and independently validates the projection digest. Do not reuse FRANKENSTEIN2_TARGET_HOST_PROFILE/v1 for the reduced shape.

acceptance_boundary.wp1202_should_not_be_reconciled_accepted: canonical WP1201->WP1202 ABI is explicit and the stale/forged profile-digest falsifier fails closed
